subtitle: Out Manila · Xiamen Airlines
overview: Fly Xiamen Airlines from Manila to Chongqing, then travel to Chengdu and Dujiangyan for the Panda Park or Panda Valley and Zhongshuge Bookstore. Back in Chongqing you see the Liziba light rail, Jiefangbei, Hongya Cave by night and Ciqikou Ancient Town. Hotels are 4-star. This is a shopping-stop package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 8–12 2026 to Mar 9–13 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Broad and Narrow Alley: Two historic lanes in Chengdu lined with traditional courtyards, teahouses and snack shops.
placeDesc.Chunxi Road: Chengdu's main pedestrian shopping street in the city centre.
placeDesc.IFS Plaza: A large shopping complex in central Chengdu, known for the giant panda sculpture climbing its facade.
placeDesc.Sino-Ocean Taikoo Li: An open-air shopping and dining district in Chengdu with traditional courtyard-style design.
placeDesc.Panda Park: A giant panda centre near Dujiangyan, visited as Panda Park or Panda Valley.
placeDesc.Panda Valley: A giant panda base near Dujiangyan, offered as an alternative to Panda Park.
placeDesc.Yangtianwo Square: A square in Dujiangyan with a selfie-taking panda statue, a popular photo spot.
placeDesc.Zhongshuge Bookstore: A design-led bookstore in Dujiangyan known for its mirrored shelves and striking interior.
placeDesc.South Bridge (Blue Tears): A riverside bridge area in Dujiangyan, nicknamed Blue Tears, visited for its views and lights.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing metro station where the light rail runs through a residential building, a popular photo spot.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: The central pedestrian shopping district of Chongqing, with the Liberation Monument at its centre.
placeDesc.Kuixing Tower: A Chongqing building where the 22nd floor feels like ground level because of the hillside layout.
placeDesc.Hongya Cave: A stilted riverside complex in Chongqing that lights up at night, visited for its night view.
placeDesc.Ciqikou Ancient Town: An old river town in Chongqing with stone-paved lanes, teahouses and snack shops.
